mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the cam and seeing why its off-centre edge rises and falls was worthwhile: it explained how turning can produce a lift.

leastWorthwhile.text: Mounting the bearing frames and crankshaft was straightforward preparation, with less to discover than the later mechanism test.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the light follower to hang without the spring's pull; the comparison explained why the spring mattered.

arbitrary.text: The guide's assembly order wasn't obvious to me: I tried attaching it to the mechanism, but it had to join the rod first. The feedback clarified it.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see how the lifter makes the paper dragon wave; the cam and spring test made the mechanism worth exploring.
